description: List/filter people (contacts). Supports cursor pagination, raw filter/order_by, and relation depth. Twenty REST: GET /rest/people.

depth.description: How deep to hydrate related records: 0, 1, or 2.

ending_before.description: Pagination cursor — return records before this cursor (from a previous page's pageInfo).

filter.description: Raw Twenty filter string, passed verbatim as ?filter=. Syntax: field[comparator]:value, e.g. `employees[gte]:100` or `stage[eq]:"MEETING"`. Comparators: eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, is, like, ilike, startsWith.

limit.description: Results per page (1-60, default 20 — Twenty caps at 60).

order_by.description: Raw Twenty ordering string, passed verbatim as ?order_by=, e.g. `createdAt[DescNullsLast]`.

starting_after.description: Pagination cursor — return records after this cursor (from a previous page's pageInfo).

name: twenty_list_people
title: List people
